name: Letter Writer
description: Teaches the brain to write a letter or email from scratch (a complaint, a request, a thank you, a cancellation, a note to a landlord, school or office) using only the facts you give, polite and firm, with every gap left [in square brackets] for you to fill. It does not send anything, make legal claims or add threats. It adds no tools of its own and fetches nothing.
author: Cypher Sisters
consent: This skill is text the brain reads. It runs nothing, stores nothing and uses no internet.
